name: F M Corporation
old_description: Since 1980, FM Corporation has been providing high quality structural foam and injection molded parts. Centrally located in the U.S., we have the ability to effectively service anywhere in the country along with our overseas customers.
about:
FM Corporation was founded in 1980 in Rogers, Arkansas, as a provider of structural foam and injection molded parts. The company remains centrally located in the United States, serving customers nationwide and overseas from its Arkansas headquarters.

The manufacturer operates a 165,000-square-foot main facility that houses both high-pressure and structural foam injection molding, capable of producing parts from 5 ounces to 75 pounds. An in-house finishing department handles sanding, masking, painting, unmasking, and logo application. A 10,000-square-foot climate-controlled assembly area and a separate 40,000-square-foot metals division provide turning, milling, punching, and bending services. Several employees have more than 30 years of tenure with the company.

FM Corporation serves the automotive and aerospace/defense industries, producing components such as automotive parts and manufacturing support trays. The company states it has the ability to serve all industries, though only those two sectors are explicitly named.

The company emphasizes that consolidating molding, finishing, assembly, and metal fabrication under one roof reduces lead times and improves quality. It maintains ISO 9001:2015 certification and describes quality as the basis of its business.
